sentences.text: On 1.31, an init container declared with `restartPolicy` set to `Always` is treated as a sidecar and starts and remains running for the entire lifetime of the Pod.

citations.quote: If an init container is created with its `restartPolicy` set to `Always`, it will start and remain running during the entire life of the Pod.

gaps: The 1.27 documentation excerpts do not cover this.
